
		<h2>
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/davablog/p/19367583" title="发布于 2025-12-18 17:13">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">基于Python实现微信通知和预警</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText"><div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p class="otl-paragraph">一、功能定义：</p>
<ol>
<li class="otl-paragraph">当系统正常时给某微信群发送“成功“消息</li>
<li class="otl-paragraph">当系统异常时给某值班人员打微信电话，提醒其登陆系统排查解决问题</li>
</ol>
<p class="otl-paragraph">二、技术方案：</p>
<ol>
<li class="otl-paragraph">核心模块：pyautogui，模拟人工鼠标和键盘操作</li>
<li class="otl-paragraph">重要功能：locateCenterOnScreen，利用该图像识别方法可以匹配界面中某个区域，比如需要点击微信聊天框中的“电话”图标。</li>
</ol>
<p>三、代码实现：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code"><img id="code_img_closed_597b3470-4051-4bf8-b943-c983e54746c9" class="code_img_closed lazyload" data-src="http://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif"><img id="code_img_opened_597b3470-4051-4bf8-b943-c983e54746c9" class="code_img_opened lazyload" style="display: none" data-src="http://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif">
<div id="cnblogs_code_open_597b3470-4051-4bf8-b943-c983e54746c9" class="cnblogs_code_hide">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pyperclip
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pyautogui
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> show_mouse

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> locate_tpl(tpl_path, confidence=0.8<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">模板匹配 -&gt; 返回屏幕绝对坐标</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    pos </span>= pyautogui.locateCenterOnScreen(tpl_path, confidence=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">confidence)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> pos = pyautogui.locateCenterOnScreen(tpl_path)</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> pos <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">raise</span> RuntimeError(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">未找到模板 {tpl_path}，请确认微信已置顶并重新截图</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pos

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> open_app_by_search(app_name: str):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">查找软件并打开</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 按 Win 键呼出开始菜单</span>
    pyautogui.press(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">win</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    time.sleep(</span>0.5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 输入软件名</span>
    pyautogui.write(app_name, interval=0.1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    time.sleep(</span>0.1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 回车打开（默认第一项就是）</span>
    pyautogui.press(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">enter</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    time.sleep(</span>1)          <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 给软件启动留时间</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> record_active_window():
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">返回当前活动窗口的坐标+尺寸 dict</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    win </span>= pyautogui.getActiveWindow()     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 当前获得焦点的窗口</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">title</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: win.title,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">left</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: win.left,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">top</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: win.top,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">width</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: win.width,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">height</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: win.height,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">box</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: (win.left, win.top, win.width, win.height)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> region 直接可用</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> search_friend_and_open_chatbox(sw_posi_info, friend):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">搜索某个联系人或者群并打开聊天窗口</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 获取微信左上角输入框位置</span>
    search_input_x = sw_posi_info[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">left</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] + 150<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    search_input_y </span>= sw_posi_info[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">top</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] + 32

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 点击输入框</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    pyautogui.click(search_input_x, search_input_y)
    show_mouse.click_with_ring(search_input_x, search_input_y)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 输入好友昵称并回车搜索（用 pyperclip 避免中文输入乱码）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    pyperclip.copy(friend)
    pyautogui.hotkey(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ctrl</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">v</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    time.sleep(</span>1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    pyautogui.press(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">enter</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    time.sleep(</span>2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> send_wechat_msg(friend, send_msg):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">给某个微信好友或者微信群发消息</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 打开微信</span>
    open_app_by_search(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">weixin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    pyautogui.press(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">enter</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    time.sleep(</span>2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 获取软件的坐标</span>
    sw_posi_info =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> record_active_window()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">print(sw_posi_info)</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 搜索联系人并打开聊天框</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    search_friend_and_open_chatbox(sw_posi_info, friend)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 找到消息输入框，并点击获取焦点</span>
    send_button_x = sw_posi_info[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">left</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] + sw_posi_info[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">width</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] - 100<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    send_button_y </span>= sw_posi_info[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">top</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] + sw_posi_info[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">height</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] - 100<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    pyautogui.click(send_button_x, send_button_y)
    show_mouse.click_with_ring(send_button_x, send_button_y)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 粘贴要发送的消息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    pyperclip.copy(send_msg)
    pyautogui.hotkey(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ctrl</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">v</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    time.sleep(</span>0.3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 6. 点击发送按钮</span>
    send_button_x = sw_posi_info[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">left</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] + sw_posi_info[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">width</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] - 100<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    send_button_y </span>= sw_posi_info[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">top</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] + sw_posi_info[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">height</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] - 32<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    pyautogui.click(send_button_x, send_button_y)
    show_mouse.click_with_ring(send_button_x, send_button_y)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> send_wechat_call(friend):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">给某个微信好友打微信电话</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>

    open_app_by_search(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">weixin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    pyautogui.press(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">enter</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    time.sleep(</span>2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 获取软件的坐标</span>
    sw_posi_info =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> record_active_window()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">print(sw_posi_info)</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 搜索联系人并打开聊天框</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    search_friend_and_open_chatbox(sw_posi_info, friend)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 搜索打电话图标的位置</span>
    call_pic = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">wechat_call_pic.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 提前截图准备好的打电话图标</span>
    call_pic_x, call_pic_y =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> locate_tpl(call_pic)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">print(call_pic_x)</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">print(call_pic_y)</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 点击图标并拨打电话</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    pyautogui.click(call_pic_x, call_pic_y)
    show_mouse.click_with_ring(call_pic_x, call_pic_y)</span></pre>

<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tkinter as tk

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> click_with_ring(x, y, r=30, ms=400<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">在 (x,y) 画一个逐渐消失的圆环，模拟点击特效</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    root </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tk.Tk()
    root.overrideredirect(True)          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 无边框</span>
    root.attributes(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-topmost</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, True)    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 置顶</span>
    root.attributes(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-transparentcolor</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">white</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 白色全透明</span>
    root.geometry(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{r*2}x{r*2}+{x-r}+{y-r}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    c </span>= tk.Canvas(root, bg=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">white</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, highlightthickness=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">0)
    c.pack(fill</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">both</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, expand=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True)
    ring </span>= c.create_oval(2, 2, r*2-2, r*2-2, outline=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">red</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, width=3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> fade(alpha=255<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> alpha &lt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
            root.destroy()
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        c.itemconfig(ring, fill</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">#%02x0000</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> %<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> alpha)
        root.after(int(ms</span>/15), fade, alpha-17<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    fade()
    root.mainloop()</span></pre>
</div>
<span class="cnblogs_code_collapse">show_mouse</span></div>
<p>四、注意点&amp;Tips：</p>
<ol>
<li class="otl-paragraph">搜索微信群名时，用拼音即可直接定位群名，而用中文反而无法直接定位群（中文搜索可以直接定位好友，群需要再手动选择，多了一步操作）。</li>
<li class="otl-paragraph">pyautogui运行时，Python脚本后台进程会与前台操作争抢输入（鼠标及键盘），因此代码中要适时的加入一些等待，避免Python后台进程干扰前台操作。</li>
<li class="otl-paragraph">该uiautomation/PyOfficeRobot等框架方案相比，pyautogui是模拟人来操作，实际运行一段时间后，在低频操作场景下，发现微信被系统踢出的概率较小。</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="clear"></div>
</div>
